👮 **Wachiman** · review of the whole pull request, at `01dfe73`: all 26 files reviewed.

5 finding(s): 1 to fix, 4 to consider; 5 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 3.** Part 1 has one defect. The shade window is now kept for the whole session, but unlike its overlay siblings it does not handle a renderer crash. After a crash, every later countdown and REC border is invisible until the app restarts, and the user is not told. A related test name says it covers \"crash\" but only exercises a closed window. The new hide-main-window IPC, the overlay spare rekeying and the prepare/begin/release split in the engine read correctly against their callers.

**Batch 2 of 3.** Part 2 has one finding, a "consider". `recorder-store.ts` now acquires the take during the countdown. I traced cancel and failure: a cancel during the countdown releases the engine and aborts the session file, and a failure surfaces through the usual toast and restore path once the countdown ends. The issue is that the settings forwarder now attaches during the countdown. On a take with no system-audio loopback, it writes the System audio toggle back to off even when the user then cancels the countdown, so the preference is lost silently. The overlay spare gating (`capture-overlay.tsx`, `overlay-query.ts`), the neutral reusable shade (`main.tsx`) and the new engine and shade tests looked correct.

**Batch 3 of 3.** I found nothing that needs fixing in this part, only two minor suggestions. I checked the reworked recorder-store tests against the new start sequence in recorder-store.ts and they match it: acquiring during the countdown, re-acquiring when the input changes, releasing on cancel, holding failures until the countdown ends, waiting for the hide to settle, and syncing settings changed during the countdown. I did not run them. The new start-sequence section of the recording-pipeline doc is also accurate; the one gap is that the countdown-off paragraph doesn't mention the new 50 ms hide-settle wait. The second suggestion: two expectations in the spare overlay-query test only check default values, so they don't test what the test's name says.

<details><summary>What the change connects to (10 closed, 0 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**
- New IPC invoke recording:hide-main-window: hides the main window and returns whether it was visible (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:599`) — The main window disappears when the countdown ends. The recorder waits for the window to leave the capture before it encodes. If it fails: If there is no main window, it is destroyed or already hidden, the handler returns false. If the invoke rejects, the store waits as if the window had been on screen. There is no sender check, but the… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:599-604`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:650`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:380-387`.
- Shade window preloaded at launch (prewarmShade) and reused by every take (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-shade-window.ts:57`) — The countdown shade shows without waiting for a renderer to load. hide() resets the window to idle so the next take does not repaint the old one. If it fails: After a renderer crash the window stays alive with ready=true. Later shows put up a blank window and onShown fires, so the countdown runs with nothing drawn, for the rest of the session. Reported as… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-shade-window.ts:134-195`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:655-670`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:540-554`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:1028-1034`.
- Overlay spares keyed only on displays, geometry and scale; mode, intent and frame display sent as state before show (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:404`) — The overlay shows at once on every pick with the same displays. If it fails: The spare-break handlers (closed, render-process-gone, did-fail-load, unresponsive) still drop the spares, and the watchdog still covers overlays that never paint. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:398-427`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:684-708`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:651-670`.
- Settings change: reload spares only on a locale or theme change; on a mode change, just call prewarm (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/screenshot-ipc.ts:81`) — No reload on a mode switch. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/screenshot-ipc.ts:43-54`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/screenshot-ipc.ts:80-88`.
- Acquire the take (session file, screen, mic, encoder, cursor track) while the countdown runs (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:266`) — The timer starts right when the countdown ends. The mic and screen indicators turn on when the countdown starts. If it fails: If the acquisition rejects or onError fires during the countdown, the error is stored (start.failure or the rejected acquired promise). It surfaces at the end of the countdown through beginTake's cat… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:425-509`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:517-599`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:398-408`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:658-666`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:686-706`.
- Ask main to hide the main window, then wait WINDOW_HIDE_SETTLE_MS if it was visible (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:380`) — The first frame of a take started from the Record page should not show the app (this relies on the 50 ms estimate). If it fails: On rejection, catch returns true and the take waits 50 ms. The handler does not check which window sent it, but it only hides the main window. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:599-604`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/preload/index.ts:135`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/types/electron-api.ts:315`.
- A spare overlay window paints nothing until main's first state, and takes its intent from that state (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/screenshots/overlay/capture-overlay.tsx:101`) — The overlay appears with the right mode and intent when the spare is shown. If it fails: If main never sends a state, the spare stays blank. Main sends the state before it shows the window. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:232-249`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:648`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:689`.
- The preloaded recording shade starts neutral and takes its region from the state messages (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/main.tsx:57`) — A reused shade does not show the previous take's area. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-shade/recording-shade.tsx:28-52`.
- Test setup stubs the new `recordingHideMainWindow` preload call (resolves false) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/test/setup.ts:171`) — Tests only. With false, `beginTake` runs `begin()` without the 50 ms settle. If it fails: If the IPC rejects, `.catch(() => true)` waits the settle margin. The start is not failed. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:380-389`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:525-536`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.test.ts:164-166`.
- Docs describe the start sequence that acquires during the countdown (acquire, re-resolve at the end, hide, begin; cancel and failure) (`apps/documentation/src/content/docs/desktop/recording-pipeline.mdx:400-453`) — Documentation only. If it fails: The countdown-off paragraph leaves out the new hide-settle wait; reported as a finding. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:247-253`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:311-372`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:398-419`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:453-459`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:577-598`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:658-666`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:803-806`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:669`.
